model_sql.orders_enriched: WITH joined AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.member_id, o.store_id, m.home_store_id, o.ordered_at, o.status, o.gross_cents, o.paid_cents, o.refund_cents, o.quantity, o.channel FROM {{ ref('orders') }} AS o LEFT JOIN {{ ref('members') }} AS m ON o.member_id = m.member_id), valid_sequences AS (SELECT order_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY ordered_at, order_id) AS valid_order_seq FROM joined WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0) SELECT j.order_id, j.member_id, j.store_id, j.home_store_id, j.ordered_at, j.status, j.gross_cents, j.paid_cents, j.refund_cents, j.quantity, j.channel, v.valid_order_seq FROM joined AS j LEFT JOIN valid_sequences AS v ON j.order_id = v.order_id
model_sql.member_month_activity: WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT member_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', ordered_at) AS DATE) AS month_date, paid_cents - refund_cents AS net_sales_cents FROM {{ ref('orders_enriched') }} WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0) SELECT member_id, month_date, member_id || '|' || CAST(month_date AS VARCHAR) AS member_month_key, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, SUM(net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents FROM valid_orders GROUP BY member_id, month_date

business_model_usage.quote: | 有效购买 | 订单为 paid，且实付减累计退款大于零；取消与全额退款不计 | 01、02 |
| 金额与件数 | 金额用整数分；退款按原订单下单日期归属；商品件数为有效订单的原始件数 | 01、02 |
| 首购观察范围 | 先在全测试覆盖历史内，对有效订单按日期、订单号排序确定每个账户的第一笔，再按查询窗口筛选；不能理解为全部订单中的第一笔，也不代表终身首购 | 03 |
| 月内购买与复购 | 月内购买会员数为同月至少一笔有效订单的账户数；月内复购会员数为同月至少两笔有效订单的账户数；月内复购率为后者除以前者，分母为零时未定义。适用限制：仅支持完整自然月、全门店；连续多月按月分别展示，不将每月去重人数相加为跨月人数 | 03 |
本期合成测试库中 `cards.member_id` 与 `orders.member_id` 均关联 `members.member_id`（05 数据字典），这是本期已知的关联结构
成交门店与会员归属门店不同，见 05
